scientific_integrity: An elementary finite-target multinomial coupling gives the stated total-variation bound. Explicit finite enumeration supplements, but does not replace, the general proof. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite lower partition and fixed upper block size; no uniformity in growing block size or lower population. Count and regularity criterion precede this result. Related two-size equivariant occupancy subcases are not presented as novel. Potential unindexed prior equivalent remains unresolved.
title: A conditional Poisson regularity law for partition-surjective transformation semigroups
